scope.truth: three exact spherical THz paths drawn continuously around known pre-observation coarse centers
scope.comparison_axis: paired estimator replacement within each native acquisition schedule
scope.csi_metric_space: uncombined element CSI; sum squared error / sum truth energy
scope.heldout_empty_domain: null in JSON / blank in CSV; not zero

oracle_geometry_ls.label: Oracle geometry + LS gains
oracle_geometry_ls.adaptation: true path geometry; gains fitted to the same noisy observation

grid_omp_3d.label: 3-D grid OMP
grid_omp_3d.adaptation: three-step range-azimuth-elevation OMP with joint gain refit

sbl_jointfreq_3d.label: Joint-frequency SBL posterior mean
sbl_jointfreq_3d.adaptation: complex known-noise sequential evidence maximisation on the full physical dictionary; all active posterior coefficients reconstruct CSI; three peaks for geometry diagnostics only

resource_fairness.paired_block: schedule, SNR and estimator within scene

search.truth_offsets: continuous random draws; no forced grid or half-grid placement
search.candidate_union: three local Cartesian windows on one global anchored lattice; overlaps deduplicated
